request.purpose: Measure current MySQL storage usage for GOLD database
request.sql: SELECT DATABASE() database_name,ROUND(SUM(DATA_LENGTH)/1024/1024,2) data_mb,ROUND(SUM(INDEX_LENGTH)/1024/1024,2) index_mb,ROUND(SUM(DATA_LENGTH+INDEX_LENGTH)/1024/1024,2) total_mb,COUNT(*) tables FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()
